judgement.reason: The outcome DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is not too lenient: the single production image serves the app, and Redis and PostgREST can be supplied or adjusted with contained changes.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yaml defines 3 application services (plugins, client, server). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The docker-compose.yaml is a development stack built from .dev Dockerfiles with dev commands, while production uses the single docker/ce-production.Dockerfile image that builds plugins, frontend and server together.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares redis (redis:7-alpine) in docker-compose.yaml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared service is Redis, which Deployz provides as single-node Redis, and the app reads it through the REDIS_HOST and REDIS_PORT settings.
